rooms.title: Millhaven Precinct
rooms.description: Officer Dana Reyes meets Sergeant Prakash at the front desk, receives the pharmacy break-in assignment, and finds the driver's name and route on the case board.

rooms.title: Municipal Records
rooms.description: Dana checks delivery manifests and a permit ledger; a mismatched route and after-hours warehouse permit connect the driver to Pier Road.

rooms.title: Station Street
rooms.description: Dana can question dispatch and follow the delivery route between the precinct, pharmacy, and Pier Road.

rooms.title: Millhaven Pharmacy
rooms.description: The frightened pharmacist describes a missing sedative bottle and a delivery made after closing; Dana documents the break-in and secures physical evidence.

rooms.title: Pier Road Warehouse
rooms.description: With the ledger, witness account, and backup called, Dana confronts the suspect, makes a supported arrest, and returns the completed case to Prakash.

facts.name: assignment
facts.text: A pharmacy break-in involved an unaccounted-for bottle of sedative. The delivery driver claims he left before closing.

facts.name: driver_route
facts.text: The driver's signed route sheet places his van at the pharmacy after closing, despite his statement.

facts.name: warehouse_link
facts.text: The permit ledger and pharmacist's account connect the driver and missing bottle to a Pier Road warehouse.

facts.name: backup_protocol
facts.text: Dana must call dispatch and take Officer Bud before entering the warehouse; entering alone is dangerous.

facts.name: case_standard
facts.text: The arrest and final report require the route discrepancy, documented pharmacy evidence, warehouse link, and backup call.

quests.description: Call backup, bring Bud, and confront the suspect with the connected evidence.

quests.name: File the case
quests.description: Return to Prakash with a complete, documented case and finish Dana's first shift.

args.title: Millhaven Precinct
args.description: Greenish fluorescent light falls across the front desk. Sergeant Prakash stands behind a stack of forms, and the case board lists the pharmacy break-in. A records corridor opens to the left; the front doors lead to Station Street on the right.

interactions.response: Prakash taps the folder. "A bottle of sedative is missing from the pharmacy. The delivery driver says he left before closing. Check the route sheet before you decide what that means."

The board names the driver as Eli Bell. His van was assigned a Pier Road relay stop after the pharmacy delivery. Prakash has pinned a note: compare Bell's signed route with his statement, then check the pharmacy and records.
Your badge and radio are on your duty belt. The radio is charged; dispatch can repeat the driver's route when you need it.
Prakash is waiting beside the case board. The desk has a file tray for forms that arrive in the wrong order. The corridor is to the left; Station Street is through the doors on the right.
